name: InlineShapes
description: A collection of InlineShape objects that represent all the inline shapes in a document, range, or selection.
remarks: Use the InlineShapes property to return the InlineShapes collection. The following example converts each inline shape in the active document to a Shape object. Use the New method to create a new picture as an inline shape. Use the AddPicture and AddOLEObject methods to add pictures or OLE objects and link them to a source file. Use the AddOLEControl method to add an ActiveX control. Shape objects are anchored to a range of text but are free-floating and can be positioned anywhere on the page. Use the ConvertToInlineShape method and the ConvertToShape method to convert shapes from one type to the other. You can convert only pictures, OLE objects, and ActiveX controls to inline shapes. The Count property for this collection in a document returns the number of items in the main story only. To count items in other stories use the collection with the Range object. When you open a document created in an earlier version of Word, pictures are converted to inline shapes.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified InlineShapes object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of inline shapes in the collection. Read-only.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an individual InlineShape object in a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The individual object to be returned. Can be a Long indicating the ordinal position of the individual object.

methods.name: AddPicture
methods.signature: AddPicture(FileName As String, [LinkToFile As Variant], [SaveWithDocument As Variant], [Range As Variant]) As InlineShape
methods.description: Adds a picture to a document. Returns an InlineShape object that represents the picture.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The path and file name of the picture.

parameters.name: LinkToFile
parameters.description: True to link the picture to the file from which it was created. False to make the picture an independent copy of the file. The default value is False.

parameters.name: SaveWithDocument
parameters.description: True to save the linked picture with the document. The default value is False.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The location where the picture will be placed in the text. If the range isn't collapsed, the picture replaces the range; otherwise, the picture is inserted. If this argument is omitted, the picture is placed automatically.

methods.name: AddOLEObject
methods.signature: AddOLEObject([ClassType As Variant], [FileName As Variant], [LinkToFile As Variant], [DisplayAsIcon As Variant], [IconFileName As Variant], [IconIndex As Variant], [IconLabel As Variant], [Range As Variant]) As InlineShape
methods.description: Creates an OLE object. Returns the InlineShape object that represents the new OLE object.

parameters.name: ClassType
parameters.description: The name of the application used to activate the specified OLE object.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The file from which the object is to be created. If this argument is omitted, the current folder is used. You must specify either the ClassType or FileName argument for the object, but not both.

parameters.name: LinkToFile
parameters.description: True to link the OLE object to the file from which it was created. False to make the OLE object an independent copy of the file. If you specified a value for ClassType, the LinkToFile argument must be False. The default value is False.

parameters.name: DisplayAsIcon
parameters.description: True to display the OLE object as an icon. The default value is False.

parameters.name: IconFileName
parameters.description: The file that contains the icon to be displayed.

parameters.name: IconIndex
parameters.description: The index number of the icon within IconFileName. The order of icons in the specified file corresponds to the order in which the icons appear in the Change Icon dialog box (Insert menu, Object dialog box) when the Display as icon check box is selected. The first icon in the file has the index number 0 (zero). If an icon with the given index number doesn't exist in IconFileName, the icon with the index number 1 (the second icon in the file) is used. The default value is 0 (zero).

parameters.name: IconLabel
parameters.description: A label (caption) to be displayed beneath the icon.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The range where the OLE object will be placed in the text. The OLE object replaces the range, unless the range is collapsed. If this argument is omitted, the object is placed automatically.

methods.name: AddOLEControl
methods.signature: AddOLEControl([ClassType As Variant], [Range As Variant]) As InlineShape
methods.description: Creates an ActiveX control (formerly known as an OLE control). Returns the InlineShape object that represents the new ActiveX control.

parameters.name: ClassType
parameters.description: The programmatic identifier for the ActiveX control to be created.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The range where the ActiveX control will be placed in the text. The ActiveX control replaces the range, if the range isn't collapsed. If this argument is omitted, the Active X control is placed automatically.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Inserts an empty, 1-inch-square Word picture object surrounded by a border. This method returns the new graphic as an InlineShape object.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The location of the new graphic.

methods.name: AddHorizontalLine
methods.signature: AddHorizontalLine(FileName As String, [Range As Variant]) As InlineShape
methods.description: Adds a horizontal line based on an image file to the current document.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The file name of the image you want to use for the horizontal line.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The range above which Microsoft Word places the horizontal line. If this argument is omitted, Word places the horizontal line above the current selection.

methods.name: AddHorizontalLineStandard
methods.description: Adds a horizontal line to the current document.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The range above which Microsoft Word places the horizontal line. If this argument is omitted, Word places the horizontal line above the current selection.

methods.name: AddPictureBullet
methods.signature: AddPictureBullet(FileName As String, [Range As Variant]) As InlineShape
methods.description: Adds a picture bullet based on an image file to the current document. Returns an InlineShape object.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The file name of the image you want to use for the picture bullet.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The range to which Microsoft Word adds the picture bullet. Word adds the picture bullet to each paragraph in the range. If this argument is omitted, Word adds the picture bullet to each paragraph in the current selection.

methods.name: AddSmartArt
methods.signature: AddSmartArt(Layout As SmartArtLayout, [Range As Variant]) As InlineShape
methods.description: Inserts a SmartArt graphic as an inline shape into the active document.

parameters.name: Layout
parameters.description: A SmartArtLayoutobject that specifies the layout for the SmartArt graphic.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: Specifies the text to which the SmartArt graphic is bound. If Range is specified, the SmartArt graphic is positioned at the beginning of the first paragraph in the range. If this argument is omitted, the range is selected automatically, and the SmartArt graphic is positioned relative to the top and left edges of the page.

methods.name: AddWebVideo
methods.signature: AddWebVideo(EmbedCode As String, VideoWidth As Variant, VideoHeight As Variant, [PosterFrameImage As Variant], [Url As Variant], [Range As Variant]) As InlineShape
methods.description: Adds a new web video to the document.

parameters.name: EmbedCode
parameters.description: The embed code for the video.

parameters.name: VideoWidth
parameters.description: An integer that represents the width of the web video in pixels.

parameters.name: VideoHeight
parameters.description: An integer that represents the height of the web video in pixels.

parameters.name: PosterFrameImage
parameters.description: A string that points to the file to use as the poster frame for the web video.

parameters.name: Url
parameters.description: The URL to the video.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The range at which to insert the web video. If _Range_ is omitted, the current selection is used.

methods.name: AddChart2
methods.signature: AddChart2([Style As Long], [Type As XlChartType], [Range As Variant], [NewLayout As Variant]) As InlineShape
methods.description: Adds a chart to the document. Returns an InlineShape object that represents the chart and adds it to the specified collection.

parameters.name: Style
parameters.description: The chart style. Use "-1" to get the default style for the chart type specified in Type.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The range where the chart will be placed in the text. The chart replaces the range, unless the range is collapsed. If this argument is omitted, the chart is placed automatically.

parameters.name: NewLayout
parameters.description: If _NewLayout_ is true, the chart is inserted by using the new dynamic formatting rules (Title is on, and Legend is on only if there are multiple series).

methods.name: Add3DModel
methods.signature: Add3DModel(FileName As String, [LinkToFile As Variant], [SaveWithDocument As Variant], [Range As Variant]) As InlineShape
